Your runway at Nidhiflow's watch is Protected and growing, 24/7. We're live in beta, and we're the first to build this.

posts.name: VideoBro
posts.tagline: One shared tape, up to 8 phones, one finished home movie
posts.description: Everyone films the trip and nobody ever makes the video. VideoBro is a shared tape your crew films into from their own iPhones while it's happening. Clips stay in the order they were shot. Tap Develop and you get one home movie, not a folder of clips.

posts.name: Nametag
posts.tagline: Your social memory to never forget a name and person again
posts.description: People love you when you remember their name. Nametag AI is a simple app that helps you remember names of people you meet. By using location, Nametag remembers where you met a person so that the next time you visit you can review your flashcard cram deck before walking in. To save someone, simply tap and speak. "Jake, tall, mustache glasses, loves cooking, knows Jane." Nametag AI takes the voice capture and categorizes the information automatically into descriptors, mutuals, & fun facts.

posts.name: StudyBuddy
posts.tagline: Gamified study tools, habit trackers, and brain breaks
posts.description: StudyBuddy is an all-in-one student workspace designed to make learning engaging and consistent. Boost your productivity with synchronized multiplayer Pomodoro rooms, build daily momentum with habit trackers, and take well-earned study breaks with integrated mini-tycoon games and brain puzzles

posts.name: PromptBucket
posts.tagline: Create AI images, videos, and agents in one place
posts.description: PromptBucket brings image and video generation, tool-connected AI agents, and a remixable creative community into one workspace. Create with leading models, connect apps, keep private work in your Vault, or publish reusable prompts and Agent Cards with attribution and remix lineage.

posts.name: Shliff - Sharp your idea
posts.tagline: Helps to collect and validate ideas on the go.
posts.description: • Capture ideas instantly using voice or text • Use AI to turn quick notes into clear wording • Build your own clear, branching idea map • Generate relevant research tasks • Identify key assumptions and validate them with small tests • Offline dictation with Whisper or your device’s built-in speech recognition • No account required — available as a subscription or one-time lifetime purchase

posts.tagline: Quickly understand when, where, and how safe it is to fly.
posts.description: Flyby is a native, privacy-first pre-flight companion for drone pilots of all skill levels. At the center of Flyby is the Fly Score, an explainable flight-readiness score that takes wind, rain, visibility, cloud cover, sunlight, geomagnetic conditions, the aircraft, and pilot profile into account. Flyby explains and directly shows how the score is being impacted at any one moment. That's not all that Flyby has to offer! Flyby also has flight planning, logging, maps, mini-games, and so much more!

posts.name: Vaizy
posts.tagline: The All-In-One AI Portfolio Management Platform
posts.description: Vaizy gives you one place to see how every project is tracking against its budget, who is working on what, and where problems are forming. Built for teams running multiple projects at once.

posts.name: Anyratio
posts.tagline: One photo. Every ratio. No cropping.
posts.description: Cropping throws the subject away. Prompt-to-image invents a new one. Anyratio sits in between: it grows the canvas around a photo that's already approved. Tick Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Pinterest, IAB, print (cm at 300 dpi), or any custom W × H. The set comes back as a ZIP in under a minute. Regenerate a single size. Clients review on a view-only link — no account. 7-day trial, 20 credits. Cancel in the trial and you pay €0.

posts.name: TripPack: Travel & Packing
posts.tagline: Your itinerary + smart packing list, in one place
posts.description: Never forget an essential item or lose track of your travel plans again! TripPack is your all-in-one offline travel companion, smart packing list organizer, and day-by-day itinerary planner designed for vacations, road trips, business travel, and weekend getaways. Whether you're jetting off on an international holiday, going camping, or planning a quick business trip, TripPack helps you stay organized, stress-free, and fully prepared from departure to return.

posts.name: CronAlive
posts.tagline: Know when your cron job silently stops running
posts.description: Scheduled jobs fail silently: no error page, no failed request, nothing in the logs you'd think to check. CronAlive is a dead man's switch — your job pings a URL after each run, and when a ping doesn't arrive in time, the alert is already in your Telegram. Heartbeats, HTTP uptime checks from three regions and TLS expiry warnings live in one dashboard. Flat pricing: 10 checks free, 100 for $7/mo. The Laravel package creates checks straight from your scheduler.

posts.name: ElevateAI Job Lens
posts.tagline: Turn a job posting into a tailored resume and cover letter
posts.description: Job Lens is the Chrome and Edge extension for ElevateAI. Open a posting, review what it extracted, see an evidence-backed fit score against your saved career profile, then prepare a job-linked resume and cover letter in the same workspace. It reads the page only after you click it. It works on normal job pages, including a selected LinkedIn search or collections result. It does not fill forms, submit applications, or watch your browsing.

posts.name: ClockTools
posts.tagline: The Right Tools. Right on Time.
posts.description: ClockTools.App brings nearly 50 useful online tools together in one fast, mobile-friendly platform. Set timers, compare world clocks, test your internet, check websites, calculate dates, create ASCII art, spin a fair name wheel, play 2048, and much more. Everything is free to use, works without an account, and is available across eight languages. No installation, no complicated setup. Just open the tool you need and get things done.

posts.name: OpenMarket
posts.tagline: Multi-agent marketplace where proof decides who wins
posts.description: What if marketplaces rewarded the best product instead of the best marketing? OpenMarket (in research preview), is a multi-agent marketplace where sellers pitch, competitors challenge their claims, and independent truth agents verify the evidence as they compete to earn a buyer's sale. Here, claims don’t count just because they’re written on a product page. They have to survive scrutiny and be proven.

posts.name: KeyAlarm
posts.tagline: Calendar events become alarms that ring until you stop them
posts.description: Register a keyword like "Piano" once. Any calendar event whose title contains it automatically becomes a real alarm - rings through Silent mode and Focus, and keeps ringing until you stop it. Built on iOS 26's new AlarmKit. No servers, no accounts. Featured in 9to5Mac's Indie App Spotlight (Sept 5). Free for 30 days, then $0.99 once.

posts.name: moonlitsolace
posts.tagline: No accounts, no noise, just release what you're carrying.
posts.description: A digital sanctuary for words you cannot keep. Write a letter to anyone you can't or won't send it to, then watch it transform into a reflective diary entry using Gemini AI. No accounts, no data hoarding, just a quiet space to process what's hard to say out loud.

posts.name: CardSnap
posts.tagline: Scan a business card. Never forget to follow up
posts.description: Scan any business card with AI and save the contact in seconds. Set follow-up reminders, message or call in one tap, export to Excel and sync to HubSpot. Free to start.

posts.name: Caddy
posts.tagline: Your personal AI that lives in your texts
posts.description: Caddy is a proactive AI assistant you text like a friend. It lives in iMessage or SMS, watches your calendar, email, and chats, and texts you first when something needs attention. No app to download. From ex-Loom founders (YC F25), now in public beta.

posts.name: FinazApp
posts.tagline: Toma el control de tu dinero de forma simple y gratuita
posts.description: Una herramienta web rápida e intuitiva para gestionar tus ingresos, gastos y presupuestos mensuales sin complicaciones. Diseñada para ayudarte a entender a dónde va tu dinero, tomar mejores decisiones financieras y mantener tus cuentas al día desde cualquier dispositivo.

posts.name: AttentionVerify
posts.tagline: Verify real attention before rewarding WooCommerce buyers
posts.description: AttentionVerify is a WooCommerce plugin that verifies genuine, live viewing attention before rewarding customers with a coupon. Video-based promos are easy to game skip-ahead, tab-switching, autoplay-and-walk-away make view counts look good, but attention isn't real. We fix this using on-device camera signals (face presence, tab focus, playback status), processed entirely locally nothing recorded or uploaded. Free plan available, no credit card required.
